verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to deep space in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the first time humans will travel that far into space since 1972" (R1/R2); "for the first time in over 50 years" (R5); "venture beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years" (R6); "first time since the Apollo program over 50 years ago" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Artemis II as the first crewed deep space mission since Apollo/1972, over 50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day NASA mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day journey" (R1/R2); "The 10-day Artemis II mission" (R5); "mission is expected to last about 10 days" (R6); "nearly 10 days ago" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as a 10-day mission across sources; R4 notes 9 days+ but aligns closely.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will fly farther than any human before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "break Apollo 13’s record... for the farthest distance humans have traveled from Earth" (R5); "the crew will travel farther from Earth than any humans have before" (R6); "farther from Earth than they've ever been, breaking a record set by Apollo 13" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm breaking previous distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space navigation, propulsion, and life support systems while human crew are aboard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test flight of... Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "first full-up test of NASA's deep-space exploration system with astronauts onboard... test life-support, navigation and communications systems" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: R6 uses 'first full-up test' phrasing exactly for deep-space systems including listed components with crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first time humans have traveled toward the Moon since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first time humans will travel that far into space since 1972" (R1/R2); "first mission to carry humans toward the moon since... 1972" (R6); "returned humans to the moon for the first time since the Apollo program over 50 years ago" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported as first toward Moon/deep space since 1972.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a direct precursor to landing the first woman and first person of color on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "major step toward returning people to the lunar surface" (R1/R2); "critical stepping stone toward future Artemis missions that aim to put astronauts on the lunar surface" (R6); first woman/POC flybys noted but not landings (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm precursor to lunar landings and note crew firsts for woman/POC (flyby), but not explicitly 'direct precursor to landing' those specific firsts.

verifications.claim: Artemis II includes Jeremy Hansen, the first Canadian astronaut to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen... will be the first non-American to journey beyond low Earth orbit" (R1/R2); "Hansen will be the first Canadian to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly first non-American/Canadian beyond LEO/to Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, and Mission Specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen" (R5); same listing (R6, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew roles and names match across sources.
